DPS:n kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin osallistumispyynnössä ja sen liitteissä, erityisesti liitteessä Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kohde. Dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä on jaettu 5 eri koriin (osa-alueeseen): 1: Potilastietojärjestelmien tekoälyratkaisut 2: Sote-toimialan fyysiset tekoälyä hyödyntävät laitteet ja robotit 3: Sote-toimialan ja pelastustoimen tekoälyratkaisut 4: Muut kuin sote-toimialan tekoälyratkaisut 5: Tehtävien ja prosessien automatisointiratkaisut Ehdokas voi hakeutua koreihin 1-5. Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään voivat hakea tarjoajaksi kaikki sellaiset ehdokkaat, jotka täyttävät ESPD-lomakkeella ja osallistumispyynnöllä ilmoitetut soveltuvuusvaatimukset. Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään hyväksytään kaikki ehdokkaat, jotka täyttävät asetetut soveltuvuusvaatimukset. Kaikki kiinnostuneet ehdokkaat voivat koko dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän keston ajan pyytää oikeutta osallistua dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään. Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään hyväksyttävien ehdokkaiden määrää ei ole rajoitettu. Ehdokas hakeutuu dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään jättämällä osallistumishakemuksen. Istekki Oy voi halutessaan lyhentää tai pidentää dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kestoa julkaisemalla siitä hankintailmoituksen. Istekki Oy voi myös korottaa hankinnan arvoa julkaisemalla siitä hankintailmoituksen. Lisäksi Istekki Oy pidättää itsellään oikeuden sulkea tilapäisesti osallistumishakemuksien jättämisen dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään sen voimassaolon aikana (esim. loma-ajat). Tänä aikana ei järjestetä kilpailutuksia dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisällä.

Local environmental conditions and any unique opportunities for heat rejection tothe environment shall be considered- Trade off of the developed process based on opportunities for cost, power and mass optimisation and the relative complexity of technology development. Typically such applications require process heat rejection management for the propellant chill down. The miniaturization of this through highly compact heat exchangers in flight weight, propellant compatiblematerials shall be investigated- Down select the processes and elaborate and optimise a preliminary design, per propellant, whichshall be developed providing detailed layout/configuration and mass estimates. The baseline system shall be defined as modular and scalable supported by digital mock up and detailed process analysis/simulation- The activity shall be ultimately supported by the definition, manufacture and test of early, ground based, module level, breadboards for key technologies/processes.

Procedure title: Scientific advisory, online/in-person training, and online learning expertise (UCC-VEAT-2024-05)
Description: This is a voluntary ex-ante transparency (VEAT) notice. It acknowledges that University College Cork (UCC) contracted with Paris-Lodron Universität Salzburg (PLUS), for the provision of support in Scientific Advisory, online learning resource enhancement, and online & in-person training for the Copernicus Atmospheric Monitoring Service and Copernicus Climate Change Service, under the competitively won ECMWF Service Contract CJS2_156b_UCC. Under CJS2_156b_UCC, UCC is leading a Service team to provide support to the ECMWF in implementing training events and online learning resources for the two Copernicus Services. PLUS will contribute to the online learning resource, training, and Scientific Advisory activities for the overall Service contract, providing niche technical and quality control support to implement resource solutions, contribute to the Scientific Advisory Committee, and support training event implementation and online content maintenance services. PLUS were uniquely placed in terms of skillsets, professional networks and relationships to perform their role in this overall service contract, further enhanced by their good standing, and track record of excellence. They brought their Department of Geoinformatics into the Service Team, recognized as a hub for graduate education in Geoinformatics with a distinctly international orientation. Next to its rich academic portfolio, this enables the Service to benefit from more than 30 years´ experience in distance learning and postgraduate education for upskilling professionals in geoinformatics and related subjects. PLUS have extensive experience in delivering capacity building activities within and outside Europe, employing a range of Erasmus-supported instruments. For example, the department is the initiator and coordinator of the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master "Copernicus Master in Digital Earth", and they are co-founders of the Copernicus Academy, fostering the emergence of regional and virtual Copernicus hubs. Within the Erasmus Skills Alliance project EO4GEO (2018-2022), they acted as Academic Coordinator to push the Copernicus downstream sector. Additionally, they have engaged in the downstream service evolution for 15+ years in various application areas of interest to the Copernicus community, including biodiversity monitoring, disaster response, and climate change adaptation. This, in addition to their academic portfolio, uniquely places them to contribute to the Service's Scientific Advisory Committee - a key Quality Control mechanism embedded within the contract Service – while equipping the Service with their highly beneficial professional networks and Copernicus experience. This is in close alignment with the requirements of the overarching Service contract between UCC and the ECMWF, specifically to deliver high-quality, customised training and developing learning resources for Copernicus services that are quality controlled to a standard of high scientific rigour. The company was therefore selected to participate in the bid for the CJS2_156b ITT as their unique combination of skillsets, technical expertise, capabilities and networks complemented those of the bidding consortium, completing it’s offering to the ECMWF. They were integral to the awarded bid, and have been contracted accordingly.
